moveReview.claim: Cosmic destruction and accelerated expansion do not resemble the intended work of a benign creator focused on humanity.
moveReview.reason: Stars continually disappear, humanity occupies a tiny temporary location, and the universe is flying apart.
quotes: impossible to reconcile this extraordinary destructive chaotic self-destructive process

moveReview.claim: Human kinship with primates and the extinction of nearly all past species count against benevolent biological design.
moveReview.reason: Vestigial traits, near human extinction and pervasive species extinction portray life as adaptation under severe natural pressure.
quotes: this doesn't to me give the evidence of a design

moveReview.claim: Permanent supernatural authority resembles unaccountable dictatorship and empowers human interpreters.
moveReview.reason: An eternal father, king or judge cannot be removed or appealed, while claimed authority is administered by people.
quotes: the human struggle for Freedom was against the worst kind of dictatorship

moveReview.claim: Junk-DNA function and the Cambrian pattern undermine examples offered for unguided evolution.
moveReview.reason: Dembski cites regulatory roles for alleged junk DNA and abrupt body plans without clear precursors.
quotes: much of this so-called junk DNA regulates gene expression

moveReview.claim: Intelligent design infers intelligence from complex independently specified patterns rather than merely invoking creation.
moveReview.reason: Forensics, archaeology and searches for extraterrestrial intelligence distinguish purposeful patterns from chance.
quotes: patterns in nature that are best explained as the product of intelligence

moveReview.claim: Eye loss in cave animals illustrates adaptation and supports natural selection.
moveReview.reason: Animals isolated from light retain eye-shaped traces but lose costly infection-prone organs when those organs cease aiding survival.
quotes: how do animals lose their eyes the same way they got them

moveReview.claim: Accepted small-scale natural selection does not establish organismal origins or universal Darwinian sufficiency.
moveReview.reason: Antibiotic and insecticide resistance show selection operating but presuppose bacteria and insects.
quotes: natural selection certainly operates it explains how uh bacteria will gain antibiotic resistance

moveReview.claim: If God is the source of all being and purpose, goodness derives from God and evil will eventually be destroyed.
moveReview.reason: A standard outside God conflicts with God as ultimate source; present evil creates a problem of trust rather than contradiction.
quotes: God himself is the standard then God's goodness follows

moveReview.claim: Human cooperation and moral reflection can arise from social survival without divine command.
moveReview.reason: A species lacking bonding and reciprocal responsibility would not survive; persuasion develops through reflection on harm.
quotes: if we didn't have a social Dimension a bonding one uh we wouldn't survive

moveReview.claim: Biblical instructions themselves command genocide, enslavement and sexual domination.
moveReview.reason: Hitchens points to commands to kill rival peoples while sparing marriageable women.
quotes: these are instructions for rape genocide and slavery

moveReview.claim: A fallen world may leave no perfect immediate option, so harsh judgments do not alone refute goodness.
moveReview.reason: Dembski compares tragic choices, says death occurs within creation broken by rebellion, and acknowledges difficulty.
quotes: in a broken Fallen World there are often no good no Optimal Solutions

moveReview.claim: The incarnation answers the picture of a distant dictator because God enters and suffers the human condition.
moveReview.reason: Christ’s embodied suffering provides experiential solidarity rather than detached observation.
quotes: God has established solidarity with The Human Condition

moveReview.claim: Another person may pay a debt but cannot erase the wrongdoer’s responsibility, so vicarious redemption promises too much.
moveReview.reason: Hitchens distinguishes bearing consequences from making the original act no longer belong to its agent.
quotes: what they can't do is take away your sins

moveReview.claim: Big Bang cosmology’s apparent beginning mirrors creation from no pre-existing matter and opens the door to theism.
moveReview.reason: Tracing the observable universe backward reaches a boundary beyond which current laws cannot run the clock.
quotes: that seems to be uh mirrored in in the Big Bang

moveReview.claim: Quantum cosmology may permit origins without God, while cosmic destruction and extinction make benign purpose improbable.
moveReview.reason: Hitchens cites a possible universe from nothing, future destruction, accelerating expansion and extinction.
quotes: what design is that a part of is what you have to ask yourself

moveReview.claim: Secular ideologies can rationalize atrocity just as religious ideologies can, so religious evil is not uniquely probative.
moveReview.reason: People convinced of religious or secular ideals may torture or kill; Stalin, Nazism and North Korea are offered against asymmetry.
quotes: secularism can be as guilty as religion in this respect
